# infisical_app_connection_kemp_loadmaster (Resource)

Create and manage Kemp LoadMaster App Connection

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_kemp_loadmaster" "app-connection-kemp-loadmaster" {
  name   = "kemp-loadmaster-app-connection"
  method = "basic-auth"
  credentials = {
    hostname                = "loadmaster.example.com"
    username                = "<username>"
    password                = "<password>"
    port                    = 8443
    ssl_reject_unauthorized = true
    # ssl_certificate       = file("ca.pem") # CA used to verify a self-signed TLS certificate
  }
  # project_id   = "<project-id>" # Optional, only required if you want to scope the app connection to a specific project
  # gateway_id   = "<gateway-id>" # Optional, route through a specific Infisical Gateway instead of the Internet Gateway
  description = "I am a test app connection"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials for the Kemp LoadMaster App Connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `method` (String) The method used to authenticate with Kemp LoadMaster. Possible values are: basic-auth
- `name` (String) The name of the Kemp LoadMaster App Connection to create. Must be slug-friendly

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for the Kemp LoadMaster App Connection.
- `gateway_id` (String) The Gateway ID to use for the app connection. If not specified, the Internet Gateway will be used.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to scope the app connection to. If not provided, the app connection will be scoped to the organization.

### Read-Only

- `credentials_hash` (String) The hash of the Kemp LoadMaster App Connection credentials
- `id` (String) The ID of the app connection

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `hostname` (String) The hostname or IP address of the Kemp LoadMaster management interface, without scheme or path.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password to authenticate to Kemp LoadMaster with.
- `username` (String) The username to authenticate to Kemp LoadMaster with.

Optional:

- `port` (Number) The port of the Kemp LoadMaster management interface.
- `ssl_certificate` (String) The PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the Kemp LoadMaster TLS certificate.
- `ssl_reject_unauthorized` (Boolean) Whether or not to reject untrusted TLS certificates presented by Kemp LoadMaster.
